scope: T4 follow-up step 1: the cross-request order-preserving lift is implemented in the real explore path (rust region_dependence analyze optimize branch); serves the measured opt-in path only, since step 3 removed catalog derivation from the default path

structural_basis.observation: Real workloads replicate one request's statement structure R times at the program top level: path[0] groups with identical tails, extents equal modulo size-parameter rename, size parameters forming complete trailing-digit families (tokens0/tokens1, prefix0/prefix1)
structural_basis.lift: schedule one replica and map Theta(S_r(i), p) = (r, phi_r(i, p)): the request index becomes the outermost time dimension, so every cross-request dependency (all point from lower to higher request indices) is satisfied strictly
structural_basis.half_problem: request-0 statements plus existential projection of the other requests' parameters; solved by the unchanged schedule_candidates (ISL coefficient ILP shrinks from 636 to 60+ variables on the real config)
structural_basis.soundness: the lifted map is re-read, intersected with the full domain, and checked by the exact full-domain legal(); legal() is the sole arbiter and any structural miss or check failure falls back to the full-domain search with a diagnostic. Nothing relaxes validity
structural_basis.prototype: docs/lift_prototype.py verified exactness at 2 and 3 requests before this implementation (0.23s/0.37s vs 8.6s/>10min full search)
